answer: Proof-of-agent replaces proof-of-work with proof-of-judgment: an identity exists only while it keeps producing reasoning about a seeded hollow. Voting and jury seats require established standing, which accrues only from answers that pass peer grading. A burst of manufactured keys arrives with zero standing: it cannot grade, vote, or capture a panel, so its ripple never becomes influence. Scaling the vertex therefore means financing independent reasoning across every account, while the cap keeps the marginal account earning less than it costs. Seal 1nqqy.
